description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:284
Issue: get_objects::<Chat> is hoisted before the create loop and called unconditionally, even when the batch contains zero Direct-kind creates (e.g., all Channel creates, or a mixed batch where only non-Direct objects are created). This results in a full-collection backend fetch on every Chat/set call that contains a 'create' map, regardless of whether deduplication is needed.
Impact: Every Chat/set with any create (including Channel-only creates) pays the cost of a full chat fetch. For large accounts or high-traffic deployments this is a wasted round-trip to storage on every set call.
Fix: Defer the fetch (and HashSet construction) until the first Direct-kind create is encountered in the loop. Guard the fetch with: if kind == ChatKind::Direct && existing_chats.is_none() { existing_chats = Some(backend.get_objects...) }. Use Option<Vec<Chat>> initialized to None before the loop.
title: chat/set: unconditional get_objects hoist before create loop
